title: Your Vice Is a Locked Room and Only I Have the Key
writer: Luciano Martino, Sauro Scavolini, Edgar Allan Poe
actors: Edwige Fenech, Anita Strindberg, Luigi Pistilli
plot: A string of murders are committed near the estate of a degenerate author, whose abusive relationship with his wife is further complicated by the arrival of his manipulative niece.
